label: Consolidation of the restated premises reported by the #1926 survey
summary: Issue #1926 phase 2, slice 1. QUESTION: do the premises the #1926 survey reported as restatements coincide in sense, quantifier, world and carrier, and how can coinciding ones be consolidated without deleting or merging records? FINDINGS. (1) 732302a1 (q.44 a.1 co.) and 2b25a78c (q.44 a.1 ad 1) are the same proposition over the same parameters, by Iff.rfl (participatedCauseReadingsIff). Both bodies are CausesIn c x esse with c distinct from x (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3; DISAMB-BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE places STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE in sense 3). Registered logically_equivalent_to 7e4b9e8b. The ad 1 record's link to 196be87e (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_2, which adds that the cause is in act as to esse) does not match its body. That link is a pre-existing mis-tag. Replacing it with 211a6432 alone makes argument 358d8c6e use two senses of 'causing an effect' without linking c3c01e92, so truth check fails; the repair is a follow-up under #216. The equivalence does not identify senses 2 and 3. merged_legacy_ids is rejected: the records bind different Lean declarations in frozen Challenges, and their source readings differ. (2) 22954087 (MeditatorThinks I) is b0fd6cc1 (SelectedBearsOccurringThought) at the idea frame's occurrence, bearing and meditator fields, by Iff.rfl (meditatorThinksIff); registered logically_equivalent_to 500c52ab. (3) c76b6e2c (frame) is c94b5446 on the frame's ground profile for any grounding relation, by Iff.rfl (someContingentConcreteIff); registered logically_equivalent_to ec8beb5c. Every profile is the ground profile of some frame on its own ontic, so the equivalence needs only the same concreteness predicate. No other open premise states that some concrete contingent exists; the survey's other candidates state the possibility of absence (18e5bd4e, 0dc833c1) or concern a power holder. (4) The survey counted 12 power-for-joint-absence premises; this slice examined 16 related bare premises. They are not restatements. Eight state different properties of the holder (existence b517ca3e, concreteness a6906cab, one power 9856239a, invariant set-up a065c332, giving each 9f7b1778, power over esse f0ac2f76, differing exercise 5cf75a6b, GOD_4 holds it 0050b6ed). Nine are three single-proposition schemas of ModalGrounding (grounding, initiator presence, holders concrete) at three propositions; a6906cab belongs to both lists. The common grounding principle, its strength orders to two instances and their certified differences (constructive disjunctive deltas DeltaP1 and Delta607, each with Everywhere iff instance and delta) are slice 1b, branch refactor/1926-grounding-principle. An earlier draft gave a false reason for omitting the certified differences (that they need a case split on equality of propositions); the disjunctive deltas need none. (5) The duplicate argument groups (784f2278/aff41a69, 12865cf3/ba458489, fe08da3c/660673ca) are not identical records. Each carrier argument instantiates its parametric sibling at a sense carrier, as the one-argument-per-sense rule requires. The love corollaries a66e4ce3 and 54a9ccd9 now declare transcription kind instantiation, as the cogito result 39454df8 already did. Closure is unchanged: the non-transcription parametric siblings 7209fa2f and a2366ca4 conclude c691e3d0 and e3d5bece from identical premise sets. (6) The assertion (b45ca9db), doubt (95c5138f) and thinking (b0fd6cc1/22954087) occurrence premises share no primitive. An entailment between them would therefore need a bridge premise relating Asserts, Performed/DoubtsThought and Occurs/Bears; none is proved or registered. Each reaches 'some thought episode occurs' (e81971f1) by its own argument (3f9339f0; 7d7b89e7 or 187646ad; f93f2dfd), through the existing strength order or a different open realization bridge. COMPUTED EFFECT: truth frontier-diff against the merge base shows no premise change. Per truth/src/frontier.rs, the frontier reads only the relations strengthens, alternative_to, refutes, root_route and attacks; it does not read logically_equivalent_to or instance_of_schema. instance_of_schema cannot register open premises (bind-check binds both its theorems with no proposition hypothesis). So the equivalent premises still count separately in the route diagnostics. Counting them once needs a phase-4 rule change (a frontier view that quotients premises by verified equivalence). REMAINING: slice 1b (above); the 2b25a78c definition-link repair (#216); universals for initiator presence and holder concreteness with their six instances; the strength order 5cf75a6b to 906f5c39 (expected, unverified).
